北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，体感 35℃，记得防晒补水，注意防暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hot and sunny, feels like 35℃. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云风大 5级，体感 28℃ 凉爽。出门注意防风保暖哦。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy with strong 5-level winds, feels like 28℃. Protect yourself from the wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云体感 33℃，户外活动别忘了防晒和多喝水哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 33℃ under cloudy skies. Stay hydrated and sun-safe if outdoors!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 37℃，天气闷热。请注意防暑，多补水呀！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 37℃, hot and stuffy. Remember to prevent heatstroke and drink more water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 33℃ 较湿热，注意及时补充水分哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 33℃ and humid. Remember to rehydrate!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天湿度高，体感 29℃。记得带伞，保持心情愉快。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with high humidity, feels like 29℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风力 4级，体感 29℃。出门注意防风，小心着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast with 4-level winds, feels like 29℃. Be mindful of the wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 39℃ 炎热干燥。请务必防暑，多喝水，小心中暑！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 39℃, hot and dry. Be sure to prevent heatstroke and drink plenty of water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天体感 32℃。天气稍显闷热，注意防晒补充水分。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 32℃. It's a bit muggy, so hydrate and use sun protection.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 34℃。阳光强烈，记得防晒，多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 34℃. Strong sunshine, remember sun protection and hydration!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感 40℃ 炙热！请务必防暑降温，避免长时间户外活动。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels like a scorching 40℃! Please prevent heatstroke and avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 29℃ 舒适。享受好天气，注意防晒哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and feels comfortable at 29℃. Enjoy the weather, remember sun protection.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云体感 32℃，稍有闷热。记得多喝水，防止中暑。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 32℃ and a bit stuffy. Drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感 23℃，非常宜人。注意温差，保持心情舒畅。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like 23℃, very pleasant. Mind the temperature changes!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 30℃ 较湿，外出请带伞，注意及时补水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels like 30℃ and humid. Bring an umbrella and hydrate!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，风力 4级体感 28℃。舒适宜人，注意防晒防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny with 4-level winds, feels like 28℃. Pleasant weather, remember sun and wind protection.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 26℃ 舒适。天气宜人，享受美好时光吧！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels comfortable at 26℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，湿度高达 90%，体感 25℃。出门小心风大雨湿。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast with 90% humidity, feels like 25℃. Watch out for wind and dampness!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云风大 5级，体感 27℃ 凉爽，出门注意防风哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with strong 5-level winds, feels like 27℃. Take care in the wind!
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级
